The explanation says only 'yourself', but the examples use himself and herself.
The passive example 'She was picked up at the border' has no police subject, so the explanation and example disagree.
Common use meaning 'clean up what someone else has left' (pick up after your dog) is not covered; the tidy subsense takes 'room' as its object.

verdicts.quote: I picked up the tickets this morning.
verdicts.reason: This shows collecting reserved tickets (sense 2), not buying or getting something quickly or without planning.
